description: The file defines a service class 'HistoryService' that manages run histories and logs, including retrieval, listing, URL generation, deletion, and counting of run history entries. It interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models and a storage service for logs.

classes.name: HistoryService
classes.description: Service for run history management, providing methods for retrieving, listing, generating log URLs, deleting, and counting run histories.

methods.name: Optional[RunHistory] get_run_history(self, db: Session, run_id: str)

methods.description: List run history records with optional filtering by case ID and status, supporting pagination.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_log_url(self, db: Session, run_id: str)
methods.description: Generate a presigned URL for accessing the logs of a particular run based on run ID.

methods.name: delete_run_history(self, db: Session, run_id: str)
methods.description: Delete a run history record and its associated logs from storage and database.

methods.name: int get_total_count(self, db: Session, case_id: Optional[str] = None, status: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Count total run history records with optional filtering.
